SELECT c.courseid, c.coursename, c.teacherid, c.hours, c.description, c.semester, c.createtime, c.coursecode, t.teachername FROM course c LEFT JOIN teacher t ON c.teacherid = t.teacherid ORDER BY c.courseid

SELECT c.courseid, c.coursename, c.teacherid, c.hours, c.description, c.semester, c.createtime, c.coursecode, t.teachername, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(ci.classname SEPARATOR ',') FROM courseclass cc LEFT JOIN classinfo ci ON cc.classid = ci.classid WHERE cc.courseid = c.courseid) as classNamesStr FROM course c LEFT JOIN teacher t ON c.teacherid = t.teacherid WHERE c.courseid = #{courseid}
